flow.name: seed-opportunities-flow
flow.doc:name: Seed Opportunities Flow
flow.doc:description: Fires 1s after startup to load seed-opportunities.json into the in-memory Object Store

scheduler.doc:name: Startup Scheduler
scheduler.doc:description: Fires once at app startup (startDelay=1s); frequency=1yr means effectively runs once

os:contains.doc:name: Check Already Seeded
os:contains.doc:description: Checks the Object Store for the first seed record to skip seeding if already populated

choice.doc:name: Seed if Empty
choice.doc:description: Seeds the Object Store when empty; skips if data already exists

when.doc:name: Store is empty — seed now
when.doc:description: Loads seed data when the Object Store has no records

ee:transform.doc:name: Load Seed JSON
ee:transform.doc:description: Reads seed-opportunities.json from classpath and outputs Java List for foreach

foreach.doc:name: For Each Seed Opportunity
foreach.doc:description: Iterates all 10 seed records and stores each by oppId

os:store.doc:name: Store Opportunity Record
os:store.doc:description: Stores one opportunity into the Object Store using oppId as the unique key

logger.message: #['[SEED] Loaded ' ++ (sizeOf(payload) as String) ++ ' opportunity records into Object Store.']
logger.doc:name: Log Seed Success
logger.doc:description: Confirms successful seeding with the count of records loaded

otherwise.doc:name: Already seeded — skip
otherwise.doc:description: Skips seeding because the Object Store is already populated

logger.doc:name: Log Seed Skipped
logger.doc:description: Logs that seed was skipped; store was already initialized

on-error-continue.doc:name: Handle Seed Error
on-error-continue.doc:description: Catches seeding errors and logs them without crashing the application

logger.doc:name: Log Seed Error
logger.doc:description: Logs seed failure details for diagnostics

flow.name: get-opportunities-flow
flow.doc:name: GET Opportunities Flow
flow.doc:description: GET /api/v1/opportunities — retrieves all records from Object Store and applies query-param filters

http:listener.doc:name: GET /api/v1/opportunities
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts GET requests; supports query params: name, priority, highPriorityOnly, stageName

logger.doc:name: Log Incoming GET
logger.doc:description: Logs the GET request with correlation ID and all active query parameters

logger.message: #['[GET /opportunities] Returning ' ++ (vars.recordCount as String) ++ ' records | correlationId=' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Response Count
logger.doc:description: Logs how many opportunity records are being returned after filtering

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle GET Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catches unexpected errors and returns a structured 500 JSON response

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 500 Error
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes the error into a JSON 500 response with correlationId and timestamp

logger.doc:name: Log GET Error
logger.doc:description: Logs GET failure details with correlation ID

flow.name: patch-opportunity-flow
flow.doc:name: PATCH Opportunity Flow
flow.doc:description: PATCH /api/v1/opportunities/{oppId} — merges request fields into existing record; returns 404 if not found

http:listener.doc:name: PATCH /api/v1/opportunities/{oppId}
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts PATCH requests to update amount, stageName, priority, nextStep, closeDate, or probability

logger.doc:name: Log PATCH Request
logger.doc:description: Logs the incoming PATCH update request with oppId and correlation ID

set-variable.doc:name: Set updateFields
set-variable.doc:description: Captures the incoming JSON body as a plain Java map before Object Store operations overwrite payload

ee:transform.doc:name: Format Updated Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Converts the updated Java Map to a JSON 200 OK response

logger.doc:name: Log Update Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful field-level update of the opportunity record

otherwise.doc:name: Not found — 404
otherwise.doc:description: Returns a JSON 404 error when the requested oppId does not exist in the store

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 404 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Creates a structured JSON 404 error payload for the not-found opportunity

logger.doc:name: Log 404
logger.doc:description: Warns when a PATCH request targets an unknown oppId

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle PATCH Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catches unexpected update errors and returns a 500 JSON response

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 500 Error
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes the error into a JSON 500 response with correlationId and timestamp

logger.doc:name: Log PATCH Error
logger.doc:description: Logs PATCH update error details with correlation ID

flow.name: patch-close-opportunity-flow
flow.doc:name: PATCH Close Opportunity Flow
flow.doc:description: PATCH /api/v1/opportunities/{oppId}/close — validates stageName (Closed Won/Lost), stamps probability, actualAmount, and closeDate

http:listener.doc:name: PATCH /api/v1/opportunities/{oppId}/close
http:listener.doc:description: Accepts PATCH requests to close an opportunity; body requires stageName (Closed Won or Closed Lost)

logger.doc:name: Log Close Request
logger.doc:description: Logs the incoming close request with oppId and correlation ID

set-variable.doc:name: Set closeFields
set-variable.doc:description: Captures the JSON close request (stageName, closeReason, actualAmount) as a plain Java value

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 400 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Creates a JSON 400 error payload for invalid stageName on close

logger.doc:name: Log Invalid stageName
logger.doc:description: Warns when an invalid stageName is supplied on the close endpoint

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 404 Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Creates a JSON 404 error payload for the unknown opportunity on close

logger.message: #['[CLOSE] Opportunity not found: ' ++ attributes.uriParams.oppId ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Close 404
logger.doc:description: Warns when a close request targets an unknown oppId

ee:transform.doc:name: Format Close Response
ee:transform.doc:description: Converts the closed opportunity Java Map to a JSON 200 OK response

logger.message: #['[CLOSE] ' ++ attributes.uriParams.oppId ++ ' closed as ' ++ (vars.closeFields.stageName as String) ++ ' | correlationId=' ++ correlationId]
logger.doc:name: Log Close Success
logger.doc:description: Logs successful close of the opportunity with final stage and correlation ID

on-error-propagate.doc:name: Handle Close Error
on-error-propagate.doc:description: Catches unexpected errors during close flow and returns a 500 JSON response

ee:transform.doc:name: Build 500 Error
ee:transform.doc:description: Serializes the error into a JSON 500 response with correlationId and timestamp

logger.doc:name: Log Close Error
logger.doc:description: Logs close flow error details with correlation ID
